nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender at construction and updated by acceptOwnership.
Pending new owner address recorded by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public ERC20 token symbol (BUXCM) set in the token constructor.
Public ERC20 token name (BUX COIN MONEY) set in the token constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
_totalSupply holding the full token supply minted to the hardcoded address.
Mapping of token holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount; mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd: checked addition of two uints.
SafeMath.safeSub: checked subtraction requiring b <= a.
SafeMath.safeMul: checked multiplication with overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeDiv: division requiring a non-zero divisor.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only function staging a new owner in newOwner.
Pending owner confirms ownership transfer and clears newOwner.
BUXCOINMONEYCONTRACT constructor: sets metadata, mints total supply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Public transfer debiting msg.sender and crediting to via safeSub/safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no double-spend protection.
Spends allowance of from for msg.sender and moves tokens from -> to using checked arithmetic.
Returns remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Approves spender then performs an external call into spender's receiveApproval callback.
Payable fallback that always reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Owner-only rescue function performing an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
ApproveAndCallFallBack interface callback invoked by approveAndCall on an untrusted contract.
ERC20Interface.transfer externally invoked on an attacker-supplied token address.
msg.sender as the initial owner and authorization principal of the Owned contract.
msg.sender used as token holder/spender key in balances and allowed mappings.
msg.sender acting as the spender whose allowance is debited inside transferFrom.
Addition c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b with a == 0 || c / a == b guard.
Division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] that can underflow in Solidity 0.4.x.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) into an untrusted contract after mutating allowed.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-controlled token address.

edges.reason: Owned constructor reads msg.sender to establish the initial privileged owner.
owner state variable is initialized from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner, gating transferOwnership.
Caller-supplied _newOwner becomes the staged privileged owner.
transferOwnership writes the staged address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership authenticates the caller through msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner back to address(0).
token constructor assigns the symbol string.
token constructor assigns the token name.
token constructor assigns decimals.
token constructor mints and assigns _totalSupply.
token constructor credits the full supply to the hardcoded address in balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction that may underflow in Solidity 0.4.x.
balanceOf indexes balances with the caller-supplied tokenOwner.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns the value through the named return local balance.
transfer debits funds keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
transfer credits an arbitrary recipient supplied by the caller.
transfer amount tokens flows into the balance computations.
transfer reads both sender and recipient balances.
transfer delegates the debit arithmetic to safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit arithmetic to safeAdd.
transfer writes the updated balances mapping.
approve keys the allowance mapping by msg.sender.
approve stores the caller-supplied spender.
approve stores the caller-supplied token amount.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] without zeroing the old value.
transferFrom keys the allowance debit by the untrusted msg.sender spender.
transferFrom debits an arbitrary from account supplied by the caller.
transferFrom credits an arbitrary to account supplied by the caller.
transferFrom amount flows into balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom reads and then reduces the spendable allowance.
transferFrom reads the from and to balances.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance deduction.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the credit.
transferFrom writes the updated balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance into allowed.
approveAndCall keys the allowance by msg.sender before calling out.
approveAndCall accepts an attacker-controlled spender which becomes the callback target.
approveAndCall stores the caller-supplied token amount.
approveAndCall forwards arbitrary bytes payload to the external callback.
approveAndCall mutates allowed before performing the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into an untrusted contract.
The external call invokes receiveApproval on the attacker-supplied contract.
The re-entrant callback can manipulate or spend the allowance written just before the call.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner and msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token accepts an arbitrary token contract address for a low-level style external call.
transferAnyERC20Token amount tokens flows into the external call arguments.
transferAnyERC20Token sends recovered tokens to the owner address.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external call on an arbitrary token address.
The external call invokes transfer on an untrusted ERC20 implementation.
receiveApproval interface receives the from argument supplied by approveAndCall.
receiveApproval interface receives the tokens argument.
receiveApproval interface receives the token contract address.
receiveApproval interface receives the raw bytes payload.
